exposure: Mode of delivery (C-section, institutional normal delivery, home delivery)
finding: Out-of-pocket costs for child delivery in Bangladesh varied significantly by mode of delivery and socioeconomic status, with the highest costs observed for C-sections and among the wealthiest quintile.
mod_finding: The highest OOP was observed for C-section (US$ 249.89), followed by institutional normal delivery (US$ 61.62).
